newsitem.title: GERMANY: Danzas names new Germany managers.
newsitem.headline: Danzas names new Germany managers.

text.p: International freight forwarder Danzas AG said it has appointed Kristian Schleede as the new chairman of its German subsidiary.
Schleede has been responsible for administration at Danzas Holding GmbH for the past year, a spokeswoman said.
His appointment follows the unexpected decision of Michael Villinger to resign as managing director with effect from February 28 after five years in the post.

Danzas has also named Guenther Hitter, previously with Frans Maas German management, as manager of its largest division, the Eurocargo overland transport unit. -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom. Tel +44 171 542 7706; Fax+5017
